column1: RULE : 1. buy at the close when price is 2% above the 20-EMA on the monthly, weekly AND daily timeframes. 2. stop loss = the entry day's low. 3. sell when the stop is hit, or when the close falls 2% below any of the three EMAs, whichever comes first. Re-run from scratch on MANAPPURAM (NSE) over the DI window; stop is a live order that fills at the stop price (the convention that reproduces the HAL reference sheet 25/25).
